title: Chas Teaches Click — EN/SN/ZU (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar Shona Zulu language learning dry wit deadpan 104bpm upright bass brushed snare absurdist comedy language lesson trilingual warm
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
There are three main clicks in Xhosa and Zulu
The dental click, the lateral, and the palatal
Chas has a sheet of paper
And the confidence of a man who has never attempted this before

[Verse 2 - Shona, with English translations]
Kune makliki matatu akakosha muXhosa neZulu (There are three important clicks in Xhosa and Zulu)
Iyo dental click, lateral, neiyo palatal (The dental, lateral, and palatal click)
Chas ane pepa rehupupu (Chas has a sheet of paper)
Netariro yemukomana asina kumbobvira aita izvi (And the confidence of a man who has never attempted this)
Akaratidza dental click (He demonstrated the dental click)
Imba yakaramba yakanyarara zvakanaka (The room stayed politely quiet)
Dental click yakaita sezvo akafungira kuti akasiya oveni ichipisa (The click sounded like someone who forgot the oven was on)

[Chorus - Zulu, with English translations]
Ukuchofoza (Click)
Akukhona lokho ncimishi (That's not quite it)
Ukuchofoza (Click)
Uyasondela (Getting closer to something)
Ukuchofoza (Click)
Indlu iyamduduza (The room reassures him)
Ukuchofoza (Click)
Wenza kahle kakhulu (He is doing beautifully)
Ukuchofoza (Click)
Ngendlela umuntu enzeka kahle ngayo (In the way that a person does beautifully)
Lapho kusobala ukuthi akakwenzi (When it's clear he is not doing it)
Kodwa wonke umuntu uyamthanda (But everyone loves him anyway)

[Bridge - all three]
English: Joel got it on the second try. Chas took another sip of water.
Shona: Joel akaiwana paedza rechipiri. Chas akanwa mvura zvakare. (Joel got it second try. Chas took another sip of water.)
Zulu: UJoel wayithola ngokunama kwesibili. UChas waphinda waphuza amanzi. (Joel got it second try. Chas took another sip of water.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Sincerity is most of it
Shona: Kuvimbika ndiko kuinzi kwezvinhu (Sincerity is most of it)
Zulu: Ubuqiniso yibo obuningi bazo (Sincerity is most of it)
